Outstanding Meal and Service 5/5
Sep 2026 • Couples
We had a fantastic dining experience here from start to finish. The set menu had so many appealing options that it was genuinely hard to decide on just one path, and we found ourselves wanting to sample a bit of everything.
The entrée was beautifully presented, with vibrant fruits and vegetables that packed an impressive depth of flavour. The highlight of the meal, though, was the beef noodle dish. Adding a touch of chilli gave it a mouth-watering kick, and all the individual components worked together seamlessly. The tender beef, fresh spring onion, and noodles were all tied together by a rich, comforting broth that made it truly memorable.
To finish, the fried banana dessert hit the spot. It was warm and gooey on the inside, complemented perfectly by the sweetness of the condensed milk.
Overall, it was an exceptional meal that we thoroughly enjoyed. We will definitely be remembering this visit for a long time, and I would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a quality dining experience.
